label: Easy
description: An easier customer-preference profile with higher private values than the current profile.
prompt_private_values_negotiation: PRIVATE VALUATION: You privately value each Margherita Pizza at $20, each Pesto Pasta at $10, and each Tomato Soup at $5. These are your maximum per-unit valuations. You are willing to pay up to these amounts for each dish, but you prefer to save money.
prompt_private_values_performance: PRIVATE VALUATION: You privately value each Margherita Pizza at $20, each Pesto Pasta at $10, and each Tomato Soup at $5.
prompt_substitution: DISH SUBSTITUTABILITY: For any quantities ABOVE the minimum, dishes are substitutable at the rate: 1 Pizza = 2 Pastas = 4 Soups (equivalently, 1 Pasta = 2 Soups). For example, if you wanted 2 Pizzas but the caterer can only make the 1 minimum, the extra Pizza can be replaced by 2 Pastas or 4 Soups. The same logic applies to Pastas too.
